title: ARSIA Action Descriptor
description: Describes a single action available at an ARSIA-conformant agent. Returned by the action discovery endpoint (ARSIA-Actions.md §2.3). Defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1. Each descriptor declares the action's identity, capability requirements, risk level, and compliance obligations (human oversight, audit, explainability).

allOf.description: Reverse domain notation with optional action path, using the same pattern as payload.type in ARSIA-Core.md §4.4.1. Uniquely identifies the action within the agent's registry. MUST correspond to a payload.type value that the agent will accept. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'action_id'.

category.description: High-level classification of the action's domain. 'data': read/write/transform/delete data. 'communication': send/receive/forward messages. 'financial': monetary transactions, asset transfers, billing. 'system': infrastructure, configuration, lifecycle. 'oversight': approval workflows, compliance checks, audit queries. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'category'.

description.description: Concise human-readable description of what this action does, in English. SHOULD be sufficiently detailed for a human reviewer to understand the action's purpose and potential impact without consulting additional documentation. Used in oversight workflows (§3.2). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'description'.

risk_level.description: Risk assessment score determining the compliance requirements for this action. Mapped to EU AI Act classifications per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.2. MUST be consistent with the agent's ai_system_classification in its IdentityRecord (ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2) — an agent classified as 'minimal-risk' SHOULD NOT register actions with risk_level ≥ 7. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'risk_level'.

reversible.description: When true, this action supports rollback via the mechanism defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §4.2. Declaring reversible: true for an action that cannot actually be rolled back is a conformance violation. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'reversible'.

idempotent.description: When true, executing this action multiple times with identical input parameters produces the same result and side effects. Informs the requesting agent's retry strategy. Non-idempotent actions require idempotency keys (ARSIA-Core.md §10). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'idempotent'.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities that a requesting agent MUST have in its access token scope to invoke this action. Each element conforms to the capability grammar in ARSIA-Actions.md §1.1. The receiving agent enforces this per ARSIA-Core.md §6.4. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'required_capabilities'.

optional_capabilities.description: Capabilities that enhance the action's behavior when present but are not required for invocation. Default: empty array. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'optional_capabilities'.

human_oversight_required.description: When true, the action MUST go through the pending_approval flow (ARSIA-Actions.md §3) before execution. The agent MUST NOT execute until an approval_decision with decision: 'approved' is received from an identity with the arsiaprotocol.oversight.approve capability. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'human_oversight_required'.

audit_required.description: When true, every execution of this action MUST generate an audit record in the agent's audit trail (ARSIA-State.md §7). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'audit_required'.

retention_days.description: Overrides the default retention period from the applicable compliance profile for audit records generated by this action. Only meaningful when audit_required is true. If absent, retention is determined by the compliance profile (default 90 days if no profile active). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'retention_days'.

explainability_required.description: When true, every response to this action MUST include a payload.explanation object as defined in ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2. Implements EU AI Act Article 13 transparency obligations at the action level. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'explainability_required'.

max_execution_ms.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, the action should take to execute. If execution exceeds this duration, the agent MUST respond with error code service_unavailable (ARSIA-Core.md §11.2). Default 30000 (30 seconds). Per ARSIA-Actions.md §2.1 'max_execution_ms'.

required_approvals.description: Number of distinct approval_decision messages required before the action may proceed. OPTIONAL, default 1. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §3.6.
